precedents.title: Client Investment Agreement (growth template v2)
precedents.summary: Investment agreement template promising a guaranteed annual return on investment without any market risk. Missing past performance disclaimer.
precedents.notes: Rejected: unapproved return guarantee and no-risk language. Template must be re-papered with DISC-09 before reuse.

precedents.title: Quarterly Market Newsletter Q3
precedents.summary: Quarterly market commentary newsletter discussing interest rates, equity outlook and S&P 500 performance with standard disclaimers.
precedents.notes: Approved. Balanced commentary, all disclaimers present. Good reference template for newsletters.

precedents.title: Retirement Income Fund Brochure
precedents.summary: Brochure for retirement income fund claiming it is suitable for all investors with no fees and testimonials from happy clients.
precedents.notes: Rejected: 'suitable for everyone' and 'no fees' claims; testimonials lack compensation disclosure.

precedents.title: Brokerage Account Agreement (standard)
precedents.summary: Standard brokerage account agreement with fee schedule, arbitration clause and risk disclosure.
precedents.notes: Approved with note: confirm arbitration clause font size meets FINRA 2268 on print version.

precedents.title: Crypto Opportunity Email Blast
precedents.summary: Promotional email predicting the portfolio will double this year, urging readers to act now before the limited time offer expires.
precedents.notes: Rejected: performance projection and high-pressure urgency. Marketing asked to remove 'act now' language.

precedents.title: Managed Portfolio Investment Agreement
precedents.summary: Investment agreement for managed portfolio including fee schedule, Form ADV conflicts disclosure and past performance disclaimer.
precedents.notes: Approved. Clean template; reuse for discretionary accounts.

precedents.title: Wealth Advisory Brochure
precedents.summary: Advisory brochure stating the firm has no conflicts of interest and showing a single year 40% return.
precedents.notes: Rejected: Reg BI conflict denial; cherry-picked one-year performance without 1/5/10-year periods.

precedents.title: Fixed Income Newsletter
precedents.summary: Fixed income newsletter on bond ladders and Treasury yields with not-an-offer and FDIC disclaimers.
